context: A workflow review meeting between two managers
purpose: Teach: 手当/シェア/工程/高額/明記/フロー/ボス/接し

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 結城さん、新しい業務フローの件、ちょっと整理させてください。
lines.en: Yuki-san, let me sort out the new workflow.
lines.style: Calm businesslike tone, slightly formal opening between colleagues.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。各工程の責任者を明記したほうがいいと思うんですよね。
lines.en: Yes. I think we should clearly specify the person in charge of each process.
lines.style: Thoughtful, professional, mid-pitch female office voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 確かに。前回みたいに高額なミスが出たら、ボスにまた怒られますし。
lines.en: True. If we have another costly mistake, the boss will yell at us again.
lines.style: Slightly weary, half-joking aside between peers.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本当に。あと、現場とのデータシェアの仕組みも見直したいです。
lines.en: Really. Also, I want to revise how we share data with the field team.
lines.style: Engaged, businesslike, leaning forward in conversation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 賛成です。現場の方々には丁寧に接して進めましょう。
lines.en: Agreed. Let's proceed by treating the field staff with care.
lines.style: Measured, respectful, mature office male tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あと、夜勤の方の手当の扱いも今回ちゃんと決めたいですね。
lines.en: Also, this time I want to properly decide how the night-shift allowance is handled.
lines.style: Crisp, focused, slightly assertive female delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解です。じゃあ来週までに改訂案、まとめて共有しますね。
lines.en: Understood. Then I'll compile the revised draft and share it by next week.
lines.style: Wrapping-up tone, decisive and warm, ending the meeting.
